name: Steamed or Boiled Tender Baby Carrots
whyItWorks: Cooking carrots until fork-tender dissolves the tough pectin and hemicellulose cell walls, turning a hard fibrous root into an ultra-gentle, easily digested puree of beta-carotene and soluble nutrients. Completely safe even in strictures when soft.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Steam or boil baby carrots for 12–15 minutes until easily mashed with the back of a fork. Season with a pinch of sea salt and a touch of butter or olive oil.
watchOuts: Must be cooked until thoroughly soft; never eat raw or crunchy carrots during an active flare.
